title: Concept: Repository declared non-canonical
description: composer.json declares a repository that load-balances with the default one, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a repository that load-balances with the default one.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a repository that load-balances with the default one.
